sentences.text: Counsel for Applicant :- Rajendra Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.

Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State/opposite party no.1 and perused the record.

By means of this application, the applicant has prayed for expeditious disposal of case being Case No. 16322 of 2022 (State vs. Mahesh Chandra Gupta and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 40 of 2022, U/s 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Rasoolpur,
District Firozabad within a time bound frame.

entities.text: Case No. 16322 of 2022 (State vs. Mahesh Chandra Gupta and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the informant in this case.
After submission of charge-sheet, accused persons were summoned vide order dated 20.05.2022 and on 16.11.2022, charge has also been framed against them.

It is next submitted that the examination-in-chief of PW-1 has been recorded on 15.12.2022 but thereafter no effective proceeding is going on.

entities.text: Deeksha Gupta vs State Of U.P.And 6 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. states that no useful purpose would be served in issuing notice to opposite party and keeping this application pending before this Court and it may be disposed of at this stage itself.

Considering the limited grievance of the learned counsel for the applicant, learned trial court is directed to make an endeavour to decide the aforesaid case, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of one year from the date a certified copy of this order is produced before it, if there is no legal impediment.
With the aforesaid directions, this application is disposed of.
Order Date :- 18.7.2023/
